transcript.text: Now I'll query for the region with fewest orders per the working definition.

args.sql:
SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY order_count ASC
